principle: Production packaging is a reachability closure, not a directory snapshot.
builder_behavior: Files under controlled dependency roots are included only when present in PRODUCTION_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE.json; otherwise they are excluded from production packaging.
materialization_rule: Regenerate deterministically from declared roots, verification-profile scripts, execution-responsibility tools, canonical support inventory, runtime/editor dynamic roots, local Python imports and explicit package-local references; never hand-edit hashes.
